outcome: Changes in weight and body mass index (BMI) z-score from 3 to 12 months after type 1 diabetes diagnosis
cohort: 530 youth with type 1 diabetes duration of ≥1 year from the Pediatric Diabetes Consortium
finding: While BMI z-scores increased sharply from diagnosis to 3 months and then stabilized, younger children and girls showed a trend towards additional weight gain between 3 and 12 months after diagnosis.
